summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 3.2/43)

data.turoyo: iḏa šwaʕ kore šawʕi d ḥoṭe u aḥunayḏux b ḥaq diḏux, klozəm d msamḥatle.
data.translation: Wenn dein Bruder siebenmal siebzig Mal gegen dich sündigt, musst du ihm vergeben.

rationale: Third I.1 Infectum example; b ḥaq explicitly marks the offended person.

data.translation: I ate shit and sinned. I am sorry, I want you to return. I did not recognize you

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (MAC NE Story of Dawid/18)

data.turoyo: Aḏəʕ, omar, ‘Ya mōr, ḥaṭino’. Kali u+ruġzo.
data.translation: He understood, he says, ‘Oh Lord, I have sinned’. The wrath ceased.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (PrS 78/58)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Yaman dewo, anəḥli." Omər: "Məllilox, laybox d mqatlət ʕam ḥayyat." Omər: "Ḥaṭino."
data.translation: "Gnade", schrie er, "Wolf! heile mich." "Habe ich's dir nicht gesagt, dass du nicht mit den Schlangen kämpfen kannst?" "Ich habe gefehlt", erwiderte jener.

rationale: Fourth Preterit Intransitive example; context independently establishes rash fighting rather than an explicitly religious offense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (62/349)

data.turoyo: Komər tamo qayəm sġəḏle li aṯto d ruḥe, məlle: “Ya ḥurma! Ḥaṭino qumax, kobaʕno d ʕofatli”.
data.translation: Da fiel er seiner Frau zu Füßen und sprach: "O Frau! Ich habe gegen dich gesündigt; ich bitte dich, daß du mir verzeihst!"

rationale: Fifth Preterit Intransitive example; qum- marks the wronged person.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part act. (PrS 56/15)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Mor ḥaṭoyo no." Omər: "Awbelulle l dukṯo basəmto." — məllele lam malaxe, — "lo li gihano w lo li malkuṯo."
data.translation: "Ich bin ein Sünder, Herr", wiederholte jener. "So bringt ihn an einen guten Ort," befahl er den Engeln, "weder in die Hölle, noch in den Himmel."

rationale: Second Part act. example; explicit sinner property with copula, while the edition preserves its own German wording.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 2.35/5574)

data.turoyo: Komər: "Əno bu ṣəbyono, bu raḏayḏi kḥuṭeno, u bu raḏayḏi ktuyabno, səmlili ḥəǧǧe, kəmarno: “maġəšleli lu šiḏo!”".
data.translation: He says, 'I, by choice, by my own will I sin, and by my own will I repent. I make an excuse for myself, I say, "The devil deceived me!"'

rationale: Fourth cumulative Infectum1 example; Turoyo paraphrase with explicit kḥuṭeno contrasts the preceding learned quotation.

ḥaṭoyo no and inherited ḥaṭóyo-wa predicate a sinner property under Part act.; ḥaṭyono and ḥaṭino are the contrasting finite forms.

The following 5574 passage recasts the statement with explicit Turoyo kḥuṭeno and ktuyabno. This adjacency provides useful register evidence, without silently restoring ṭ in the earlier quoted form.

42/1: verify assigned maḥte against inherited maḥṭe before any source-spelling correction; do not merge it with mḥt.

Confirm kḥuṭeno vocalism and its relation to inherited ḥoṭe without normalising the recorded spelling.
